pairs.target: ménfáng bǎ xìn dìgěi tǎ wéi shí , xiān wèn tā shìbushì luò le shénme dōngxī .
pairs.english: Handing Tavi the letter, the gatekeeper first asked if he'd dropped something.
pairs.hanzi: 门房把信递给塔维时，先问他是不是落了什么东西。

pairs.target: tā shǒulǐ ná zhe liǎnggēn shéng , yuánběn shì qù xī péng kǔn dǐbǎn de .
pairs.english: He held two cords for tying the baseboard at the west shed.
pairs.hanzi: 他手里拿着两根绳，原本是去西棚捆底板的。

pairs.target: xìnfēng yí dàoshǒu , shéng tóu biàn chuíxiàlái , tuō guò ménkǎn shàng de huī .
pairs.english: As the envelope reached him, the cord ends fell and trailed through the dust on the threshold.
pairs.hanzi: 信封一到手，绳头便垂下来，拖过门槛上的灰。

pairs.target: wài fēng láizì wěi jiē .
pairs.english: The outer envelope came from Reed Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 外封来自苇阶。

pairs.target: nèi yè réng shì lín yuán de zì , lìng jiá zhe yìzhāng chāo dé hěn xì de jiùhuò dān .
pairs.english: Inside was Lin Yuan's writing again, with a carefully copied old manifest.
pairs.hanzi: 内页仍是林沅的字，另夹着一张抄得很细的旧货单。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu xiàng shàng huí nàyàng xiān zhǎo péngyǒu .
pairs.english: Unlike last time, Tavi didn't seek his friends first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有像上回那样先找朋友。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài lángzhù hòumiàn , bǎ zhǐ zhǎnkāi , dìyīyǎn jiù kànjiàn le " xiūlǐ chē sānliàng ".
pairs.english: Behind a porch pillar he opened it, immediately seeing “three repair wagons.”
pairs.hanzi: 他站在廊柱后面，把纸展开，第一眼就看见了“修理车三辆”。

pairs.target: lín yuán shōudào le hòu bǔ de niánfèn , qù wèn le cóngqián guǎn guò nán zhīlù huòdān de rén .
pairs.english: Lin Yuan had received the added year estimate and asked a former keeper of southern-branch manifests.
pairs.hanzi: 林沅收到了后补的年份，去问了从前管过南支路货单的人。

pairs.target: yuē shísìnián qián nàge dōngtiān , lù tīng de jìnàn xiūlǐ péng céngjīng qiān chè .
pairs.english: That winter about fourteen years ago, the near-bank repair yard at Reed Reach had been evacuated.
pairs.hanzi: 约十四年前那个冬天，鹭汀的近岸修理棚曾经迁撤。

pairs.target: dī xiàn liánxù jǐrì chūxiànyìcháng , pénglǐ yíbùfen rén hé qìjù xiān wǎng gāodì nuó ,
pairs.english: The embankment line had shown anomalies for several days; some workers and equipment went uphill first,
pairs.hanzi: 堤线连续几日出现异常，棚里一部分人和器具先往高地挪，

pairs.target: bùnéng jìxù yòng de sānliàng xiūlǐ chē suíhòu jiāodào yú wān , huàn pái huí yùn .
pairs.english: then three unusable repair wagons were handed over at Elmbay, retagged for return haulage.
pairs.hanzi: 不能继续用的三辆修理车随后交到榆湾，换牌回运。

pairs.target: lù tīng . tǎ wéi yǐqián méiyǒu jiàn guò zhè liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: Reed Reach. Tavi had never seen those characters before.
pairs.hanzi: 鹭汀。塔维以前没有见过这两个字。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dìyīzhāng zhǐ fān huíqù , zhǎo háizi , míngzì , yīshang .
pairs.english: He turned back to the first sheet, searching for a child, a name, a coat.
pairs.hanzi: 他把第一张纸翻回去，找孩子、名字、衣裳。

pairs.target: méiyǒu . huòdān jì de shì chē , búshì rén .
pairs.english: Nothing. The manifest recorded vehicles, not people.
pairs.hanzi: 没有。货单记的是车，不是人。

pairs.target: lín yuán tèbié xiěmíng , chē ké méiyǒu liúxià néng hé tā de cǎotú yīyīduìyìng de biānhào ,
pairs.english: Lin Yuan stressed that no surviving shell numbers matched his sketch one for one;
pairs.hanzi: 林沅特别写明，车壳没有留下能和他的草图一一对应的编号，

pairs.target: bùnéng yīnwèi jìjié jìn , jiù bǎ zhè sānliàng rènzuò tā zuò guò de nà liàng .
pairs.english: matching seasons alone couldn't identify any of those three as his wagon.
pairs.hanzi: 不能因为季节近，就把这三辆认作他坐过的那辆。

pairs.target: kě xiàmiàn háiyǒu yìzhāng tú .
pairs.english: But there was another drawing underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 可下面还有一张图。

pairs.target: tú búshì jīqì de tú , érshì qiān chè qián xiūlǐ péng de jiǎnlüè wèizhì .
pairs.english: It showed no machine, but a rough plan of the repair yard before relocation.
pairs.hanzi: 图不是机器的图，而是迁撤前修理棚的简略位置。

pairs.target: kào dī yìpái zhǎngwū , hòumiàn yǒu jǐng , jǐng páng huà le xǐyī de cáo , zài hòumiàn shì yípiàn zhù rén de xiǎowū .
pairs.english: Long buildings by the embankment, a well behind, a washing trough beside it, and homes farther back.
pairs.hanzi: 靠堤一排长屋，后面有井，井旁画了洗衣的槽，再后面是一片住人的小屋。

pairs.target: yǒurén bǎ liàngyīshéng huà chéng jǐdào duǎnxiàn , duǎnxiàn shàng chuí zhe xiǎoxiǎode fāngkuài , xiàng yìpái bèi wàng zài wūhòu de qí .
pairs.english: Clotheslines were short strokes with little squares hanging below, like flags forgotten behind houses.
pairs.hanzi: 有人把晾衣绳画成几道短线，短线上垂着小小的方块，像一排被忘在屋后的旗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòng zhǐjiān yāzhù zhǐ jiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi held down a corner with his fingertip.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维用指尖压住纸角。

pairs.target: yuánlái nàxiē xiūlǐ chē lái guò de dìfāng , huì yǒurén zài wàimiàn xǐ yīshang .
pairs.english: So where those wagons had come from, people washed clothes outside.
pairs.hanzi: 原来那些修理车来过的地方，会有人在外面洗衣裳。

pairs.target: háizi rúguǒ zài nàlǐ kū , bù yídìng zhǐyǒu jīqì tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: If a child cried there, machines needn't have been the only listeners.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子如果在那里哭，不一定只有机器听见。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào zìjǐ yòu wǎngqián xiǎng le tài duō , quèméinéng lìkè tuìhuílái .
pairs.english: He knew he'd imagined too far ahead again, but couldn't immediately retreat.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道自己又往前想了太多，却没能立刻退回来。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ de zhōngxiǎng guò yìshēng , tā tīngjiàn le , yě xiǎngqǐ mǐlā .
pairs.english: A bell sounded in the yard. He heard it, and remembered Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 院里的钟响过一声，他听见了，也想起米拉。

pairs.target: qù xī péng háiyǒu yíduànlù , xiànzài zǒu , yǐjīng huì chí .
pairs.english: The west shed was still some distance away. Even leaving now, he would be late.
pairs.hanzi: 去西棚还有一段路，现在走，已经会迟。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xìn zhé qǐ yíbàn , tíng le tíng , yòu chóngxīn tānkāi .
pairs.english: He half-folded the letter, paused, and spread it out again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把信折起一半，停了停，又重新摊开。

pairs.target: tú páng zhùmíng , qiān chè hòu de rén bìngfēi dōu qù le tóngyígè dìfāng .
pairs.english: Beside the drawing, a note said the displaced people had not all gone to the same place.
pairs.hanzi: 图旁注明，迁撤后的人并非都去了同一个地方。

pairs.target: yǒurén liúzài shàngmiàn de jiù gōngfáng , yǒurén gēn biéde chēduì zǒu .
pairs.english: Some stayed at the old workshops higher up; others left with different caravans.
pairs.hanzi: 有人留在上面的旧工房，有人跟别的车队走。

pairs.target: lín yuán kěyǐ bǎ xià yìfēngxìn zhuǎngěi réng yǔ jiù gōngfáng láiwǎng de rén ,
pairs.english: Lin Yuan could forward another letter to someone still in touch with those workshops,
pairs.hanzi: 林沅可以把下一封信转给仍与旧工房来往的人，

pairs.target: lùshang yào rào , huíyīn búhuì kuài .
pairs.english: but the route was roundabout and a reply would be slow.
pairs.hanzi: 路上要绕，回音不会快。

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí dāying rènde tā .
pairs.english: Nobody had promised to recognize him.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁答应认得他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn wán , hūrán hěn xiǎng qīnzì qù .
pairs.english: Finishing, Tavi suddenly wanted very much to go himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看完，忽然很想亲自去。

pairs.target: zhè niàntou láide méiyǒu dàolǐ .
pairs.english: The thought made no sense.
pairs.hanzi: 这念头来得没有道理。

pairs.target: lù tīng zài shénme fāngxiàng , zǒu dào nàlǐ yào duōjiǔ , tā lián yìzhāng xiànzài néng yòng de lù tú dōu méiyǒu .
pairs.english: He didn't even have a usable map showing where Reed Reach was or how long it took to reach.
pairs.hanzi: 鹭汀在什么方向，走到那里要多久，他连一张现在能用的路图都没有。

pairs.target: shūdài lǐ zhǐyǒu jièlái de suànshù cè hé yíkuài méi chī wán de bǐng , dōulǐ de qián yě zhǐshì zhè jǐtiān de línghuā .
pairs.english: His bag held only borrowed arithmetic and an unfinished cake; his pockets, a few days' spending money.
pairs.hanzi: 书袋里只有借来的算术册和一块没吃完的饼，兜里的钱也只是这几天的零花。

pairs.target: kě tā háishì táitóu wàng le yìyǎn ménwài , fǎngfú màichū qù , jiù néng bǎ xìn shàng nàxiē xiǎowū cóng zhǐ lǐ dài chūlái .
pairs.english: Still he glanced outside, as though one step could bring the little houses out of the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 可他还是抬头望了一眼门外，仿佛迈出去，就能把信上那些小屋从纸里带出来。

pairs.target: ménfáng hǎn tā , shuō shéngzi kuài ràng rén cǎi zāng le .
pairs.english: The gatekeeper called that his cords would be trampled dirty.
pairs.hanzi: 门房喊他，说绳子快让人踩脏了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shéng shōu qǐlái , wèn jièshūchù jīntiān kāi dào shénme shíhòu .
pairs.english: He gathered them and asked when the library closed today.
pairs.hanzi: 他把绳收起来，问借书处今天开到什么时候。

pairs.target: ménfáng shuō wǎnfàn qián , jiàn tā hái zhàn zhe , yòu wèn yào buyào xiān zuòxià kàn wán .
pairs.english: Before supper, said the gatekeeper, then offered him a seat to finish reading.
pairs.hanzi: 门房说晚饭前，见他还站着，又问要不要先坐下看完。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò le .
pairs.english: Tavi sat.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐了。

pairs.target: tā ná lìng yìzhāng zhǐ , bǎ lù tīng chāo le sānbiàn .
pairs.english: He took another sheet and copied Reed Reach three times.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿另一张纸，把鹭汀抄了三遍。

pairs.target: dìèrgè zì de shuǐ páng xiě dé tài dà , tā cādiào zhòngxiě , yòu bǎ huòdān lǐ de chē shù hé huí yùn zìyàng chāoxià .
pairs.english: The water radical of the second character was too big; he erased and rewrote it, then copied the vehicle count and return-haul wording.
pairs.hanzi: 第二个字的水旁写得太大，他擦掉重写，又把货单里的车数和回运字样抄下。

pairs.target: míngmíng kěyǐ wǎndiǎn zuò , tā xīnlǐ què yǒu yìzhǒng hěn jí de bèn niàntou :
pairs.english: He could plainly do it later, yet an urgent, foolish thought pressed him:
pairs.hanzi: 明明可以晚点做，他心里却有一种很急的笨念头：

pairs.target: xiān bǎ tāmen xiě zài zìjǐ de zhǐ shàng , cái búpà yì hé shàng xìn , nà dìfāng jiù yòu méiyǒu le .
pairs.english: only once it was on his own paper could he stop fearing the place would vanish when he closed the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 先把它们写在自己的纸上，才不怕一合上信，那地方就又没有了。

pairs.target: děng tā zhōngyú bǎ xìn fàngjìn shūdài , xībiān de yángguāng yǐjīng yí dào láng zhōng .
pairs.english: By the time he put the letter in his bag, western sunlight had moved into the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 等他终于把信放进书袋，西边的阳光已经移到廊中。

pairs.target: xiǎopéng de ménsuǒ zhe .
pairs.english: The shed was locked.
pairs.hanzi: 小棚的门锁着。

pairs.target: ménbiān yuánxiān duī mùpiàn de dìfāng kōng le , qiángjiǎo liú zhe yídào xīn tuō hén .
pairs.english: The wood pile beside its door was gone; a fresh scrape marked the wall's foot.
pairs.hanzi: 门边原先堆木片的地方空了，墙脚留着一道新拖痕。

pairs.target: tā qù dōng wū zhǎo , mǐlā hé yīwén zhèng bǎ dǐbǎn fàngdào gōngzuò táishàng .
pairs.english: In the east room he found Mira and Iven setting the baseboard on the workbench.
pairs.hanzi: 他去东屋找，米拉和伊文正把底板放到工作台上。

pairs.target: dǐbǎn yìjiǎo de báo biān lièkāi le , mǐlā ànzhù lièkǒu , yīwén zài dǐxià diànzhǐ .
pairs.english: Its thin edge had split at one corner; Mira held it while Iven slid paper underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 底板一角的薄边裂开了，米拉按住裂口，伊文在底下垫纸。

pairs.target: " wǒ ……" tǎ wéi tíng zài ménkǒu .
pairs.english: “I…” Tavi stopped in the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: “我……”塔维停在门口。

pairs.target: yīwén xiān kànjiàn tā shǒulǐ de shéng , liǎnshàng de xiàoyì yìdiǎndiǎn tuìxiàqù .
pairs.english: Iven noticed the cords first; his smile slowly faded.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文先看见他手里的绳，脸上的笑意一点点退下去。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu táitóu , zhī shuō : " nádào le . nǐ búyòng zài qù le . "
pairs.english: Without looking up, Mira said, “We've got it. You don't need to go now.”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有抬头，只说：“拿到了。你不用再去了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìn zài dài lǐ àn jǐn , xiàng bèi rén zhuàngjiàn le shénme , yòu juéde zhège dòngzuò bǐ chídào gèng nánkàn .
pairs.english: Tavi pressed the letter deeper in his bag, as though caught out, then felt that gesture was uglier than being late.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信在袋里按紧，像被人撞见了什么，又觉得这个动作比迟到更难看。

pairs.target: " gāng shōudào huíxìn . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “A reply just arrived,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “刚收到回信。”他说。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào nǐ yǒushì . " mǐlā zhōngyú kàn tā ,
pairs.english: “I know you have things to do.” Mira finally looked at him.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道你有事。”米拉终于看他，

pairs.target: " nǐ kěyǐ gàosù wǒ , ràng wǒ chóngxīn zhǎo rén . búshì ràng wǒ yìzhí děng . "
pairs.english: “You could tell me, let me find someone else. Not leave me waiting.”
pairs.hanzi: “你可以告诉我，让我重新找人。不是让我一直等。”

pairs.target: wūlǐ yǒurén táitóu , tǎ wéi zhàn zhe méi dòng .
pairs.english: Someone in the room looked up. Tavi stood still.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里有人抬头，塔维站着没动。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng bǎ lù tīng shuō chūlái , yòu fāxiànzìjǐ hái bù zhīdào gāi bǎ nà liǎnggè zì fàngzài shénme dìfāng .
pairs.english: He wanted to say Reed Reach, but didn't know where to put those two characters yet.
pairs.hanzi: 他想把鹭汀说出来，又发现自己还不知道该把那两个字放在什么地方。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zhǐdiàn hǎo , jiào tā xiān ràng kāimén , hòumiàn háiyǒu rén yào jìnlái .
pairs.english: Iven finished padding the board and asked him to clear the doorway; someone else needed to come in.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把纸垫好，叫他先让开门，后面还有人要进来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng pángbiān tuì le yíbù . nà liǎnggēn méiyǒu yòng shàng de shéng réng zài tā shǒulǐ , tā rào le yìquān , rào dé tàijǐn , yòu mànmàn sōngkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped aside. The unused cords remained in his hand; he wound them once, too tight, then slowly loosened them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往旁边退了一步。那两根没有用上的绳仍在他手里，他绕了一圈，绕得太紧，又慢慢松开。
